title: 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross Hybrid Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross Hybrid is a carryover model, following an update for 2026, but the base trim has been dropped for the new model year.
body_markdown:
Toyota offers the Corolla Cross in two versions. One has a standard gasoline engine, while the other features a hybrid powertrain. The 2027 Corolla Cross Hybrid that we cover here costs a little more than its non-hybrid sibling (which we cover in a **[separate article](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/2027-toyota-corolla-cross-pricing-specs-release-date)** ), but is both more powerful and more efficient.

## What’s New for the 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross Hybrid


The Corolla Cross Hybrid received a refresh in 2026 that brought a new grille painted to match the SUV’s bodywork, new wheels, and a contrasting black roof. The interior was updated and a larger digital gauge cluster was made available. The Corolla Cross Hybrid returns for 2027 with no material changes, but the model lineup has been slimmed down. The base S model has been dropped, leaving just the SE and XSE.


## Design


A unique body-colored grille differentiates the Corolla Cross Hybrid from the gas model, and a series of punched-out openings of varying sizes gives the small SUV a modern look. It rides higher than the smaller Corolla Hatchback, giving drivers a slightly more commanding view of the road. Chunky cladding covers the lower bodywork and wheel openings, lending it a more rugged look. Two-tone paint and a black roof and black rear spoiler are offered as an extra-cost option.


## Powertrain


All 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross Hybrid models feature a 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine and three electric motors, one of which is dedicated to the rear wheels. The total system output is 196 horsepower and all-wheel drive (AWD) is standard. The Corolla Cross Hybrid is estimated to return 46 mpg in the city, 39 mpg on the highway, and 42 mpg combined. The Toyota Corolla Cross Hybrid is rated to tow up to 1,500 pounds.


## Interior


With its durable upholstery options and quality materials, the interior of the 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross Hybrid isn’t exciting to look at, but should prove hard-wearing over time. The SE trim level comes standard with either black or gray cloth, while the XSE gets a SofTex leatherette and fabric blend in either solid black or a two-tone black and blue. Cargo space behind the split-folding rear seat measures 21.5 cubic feet, and that expands to 44 cubic feet with the back seat folded flat. That’s more space than the Corolla Hatchback, but quite a bit less than several competitors.


## Technology


The 2027 Corolla Cross Hybrid SE has a 7-inch digital gauge cluster and an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment display. The XSE trim benefits from a larger 12.3-inch digital cluster and a 10.5-inch touchscreen. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity are standard, along with a wireless device charger. A six-speaker audio system is standard on all Corolla Cross Hybrid models, and the XSE is offered with an optional nine-speaker premium system from JBL that includes a subwoofer. Several connected services packages are available, including Remote Connect, which allows remote control of certain vehicle features using a smartphone or smartwatch app, and Drive Connect, which includes Cloud Navigation with Google Points of Interest and Toyota’s voice-activated Intelligent Assistant. All of these connected services require an active trial or subscription.

## Safety


Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 comes standard on all Corolla Cross Hybrid models. The driver-assistance suite includes adaptive cruise control, automatic emergency braking, lane-departure alert, lane-keep assist, traffic-sign assist, high-beam assist, and more. A blind-spot monitor and rear cross-traffic alert are also standard, while XSE models also get front and rear parking assist. The 2027 Corolla Cross Hybrid had not received official safety ratings at the time of writing, but the 2025 model earned a Top Safety Pick from the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety and a maximum five-star overall safety rating from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.


## Pricing and Release Date


At the time of writing, Toyota listed the base price of the 2027 Corolla Cross Hybrid SE at $33,010 (including destination). The Corolla Cross Hybrid XSE starts at $35,725. Extra-cost options for SE models include a multimedia upgrade that adds the larger digital screens, a moonroof, and a cold weather package with heated front seats and steering wheel. The XSE model offers an optional convenience package that adds a moonroof and a power rear liftgate.
